ratings.notes: PMID 29662316 explicitly states metformin activated AMPK in CD19-CAR T cells. PRKAA1 is the alpha1 catalytic subunit of AMPK; the abstracts reference AMPK generally without specifying the alpha1 isoform, so the isoform-level specificity is inferred rather than directly stated. PMID 35072253 mentions AMPK/mTOR pathway but provides no isoform detail. Relation direction (metformin→activates→AMPK/PRKAA1) is supported, but isoform specificity reduces confidence slightly.

PMID 34062070 explicitly states metformin activates AMPK and reviews the AMPK/mTOR anticancer pathway. PMID 40140842 describes metformin as an AMPK activator used in combination with physcion. Both abstracts support metformin activating AMPK. However, neither abstract specifies the PRKAA2 (alpha2) isoform; AMPK activation is described generically. Isoform-level specificity is not textually supported, reducing confidence slightly.
